

```{r}
## Suppress messages
#| error: false
#| warning: false

## Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(gt)

## Set read_csv function option to suppress warning messages
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)

## Data input
data <- read_csv(col_names = TRUE, file =
"Common Name,    Scientific Name,         Conservation Status
Black Crowned Crane, Balearica pavonina,    Vulnerable
Black-necked Crane,  Grus nigricollis,      Near Threatened
Blue Crane,          Anthropoides paradiseus, Vulnerable
Brolga,              Antigone rubicunda,    Least Concern
Demoiselle Crane,    Anthropoides virgo,    Least Concern
Eurasian Crane,      Grus grus,             Least Concern
Grey Crowned Crane,  Balearica regulorum,   Endangered
Hooded Crane,        Grus monacha,          Vulnerable
Red-crowned Crane,   Grus japonensis,       Endangered
Sandhill Crane,      Antigone canadensis,   Least Concern
Sarus Crane,         Antigone antigone,     Vulnerable
Siberian Crane,      Leucogeranus leucogeranus, Critically Endangered
Wattled Crane,       Bugeranus carunculatus, Vulnerable
White-naped Crane,   Antigone vipio,        Vulnerable
Whooping Crane,      Grus americana,        Endangered")

## Initialize the identification information
table_title <- "Crane Species and Their Conservation Status"
data_source <- "Internet"

## Create the table
table <- gt(data) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = table_title
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = paste0("Source: ", data_source)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(v_align = "top"),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = "Scientific Name") %>%
  cols_label(
    `Scientific Name` = md("**Scientific Name**")
  ) %>%
  text_transform(
    locations = cells_body(columns = "Scientific Name"),
    fn = function(x) paste0("*", x, "*")
  )

## Use table stripes
table <- table %>%
  opt_row_striping(row_striping = TRUE)

## Output the table
table
```
Bar Chart

```{r}
## Suppress messages
#| error: false
#| warning: false

## Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

## Set read_csv function option to suppress warning messages
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)

## Data input
data <- read_csv(col_names = TRUE, file =
"Common Name,    Scientific Name,         Conservation Status
Black Crowned Crane, Balearica pavonina,    Vulnerable
Black-necked Crane,  Grus nigricollis,      Near Threatened
Blue Crane,          Anthropoides paradiseus, Vulnerable
Brolga,              Antigone rubicunda,    Least Concern
Demoiselle Crane,    Anthropoides virgo,    Least Concern
Eurasian Crane,      Grus grus,             Least Concern
Grey Crowned Crane,  Balearica regulorum,   Endangered
Hooded Crane,        Grus monacha,          Vulnerable
Red-crowned Crane,   Grus japonensis,       Endangered
Sandhill Crane,      Antigone canadensis,   Least Concern
Sarus Crane,         Antigone antigone,     Vulnerable
Siberian Crane,      Leucogeranus leucogeranus, Critically Endangered
Wattled Crane,       Bugeranus carunculatus, Vulnerable
White-naped Crane,   Antigone vipio,        Vulnerable
Whooping Crane,      Grus americana,        Endangered")

## Prepare data for plotting
status_counts <- data %>%
  count(`Conservation Status`) %>%
  mutate(`Conservation Status` = factor(`Conservation Status`, 
                                        levels = c("Critically Endangered", "Endangered", "Vulnerable", "Near Threatened", "Least Concern")))

## Set source information
source <- "Internet Data"

## Create the bar chart
bar_out <- ggplot(status_counts, aes(x = `Conservation Status`, y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "cornsilk3", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Frequency of Conservation Status for Crane Species",
       x = "Conservation Status",
       y = "Number of Species",
       caption = source) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "darkslategray2"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "black")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))

bar_out

## Save the plot (optional)
ggsave(plot = bar_out, file = "crane_conservation_status.png")

```
